teaching_cues: From layout, leg matching the hand on top of the hoop crosses over the other leg and traces the hoop. No rounded back - back straight.
From seated on bottom bar, one toe pit to top of hoop.  Use arms to pull hips up towards top bar.  Straight back.

display_name: Standing On Ground Side of Hoop

teaching_cues: From “L” Sit, one foot crosses over the other and pull up to Toe Squat.

alt_name: Knee Hang Top Bar Straight Leg Delilah (free leg bent)
teaching_cues: Come to DKH by bringing each toe pit to the top bar then bringing each knee pit to the top bar. Squeeze heels toward butt. Hands stay inside or slightly below tabs. One leg comes off and thru hoop. Free leg bends.

From Inside Lion, hands cross grip between legs with the hand matching the knee hook leg to be a palms away grip. Solid knee hook and roll forward to Delilah. As rolling, the free leg hooks on the bar. Hook will not happen naturally - must hook free leg.
progressions: Regression would be to pancake chest to leg prior to rolling.

teaching_cues: From Low Layout, remove leg that matches free hand.  Either leg may be straight or bent.  Hint for feeling steadier is to hook leg of arm on hoop prior to removing free leg.
Hand below the tab and layout.  The farther down the hand, the more core work is needed.  Flows nicely from High Layout with the hand between the tabs.
From Low Layout, remove leg that matches free hand.  Either leg may be straight or bent.  Hint for feeling steadier is to hook leg of arm on hoop prior to removing free leg.
From Dragon Fly invert to Straddle Back. May exit to Wine Glass by bringing leg on face side of hoop to rest on bar.
From seated on the top bar, wiggle one booty cheek off hoop while the other stays on. Whichever booty cheek is off, that leg wraps around same side spanset.

display_name: Half Seated Forward Roll - Legs Bent
teaching_cues: From seated on bottom bar, bring bar to mid thigh. Bring hands to slightly below belly of hoop. Bend knees into butt and keep them bent the entire time. Tuck yourself into a ball, chin to chest and roll forward. Motorcycle your hands to bring you completely around the bar. Should end in seated again or in DKH if doing half roll, which would be Level 2.

Start from Horse (SKH) on bottom bar with hand of leg hooked on the top bar and the other on the bottom bar.  Release top hand and grab bottom bar to transition to Delilah (SHK).  More advanced is to skip grabbing the bottom bar and drop right into Delilah (SKH).

display_name: Inside Lion Roll Back Drop to Delilah
teaching_cues: From Inside Lion, knee hook hand grabs bar between legs in a palm away direction.  Engage core with strong knee hook.  Head and shoulders out the back, and drop to Delilah (SKH).

From Inside Lion, hand that matches knee hook is on the outside of that leg with palms away.  The other hand is between legs with palm towards you. Solid knee hook on bent leg.  Roll forward to Delilah (SKH).

Cross grip to one side of the hoop.  This is the one exception to hand crossing over goes on top.  In this pose, the hand crossing over goes below.  Double outside knee hook on bottom bar.  Pull up to Profile Plank.  Outside leg (leg matching hand on top) comes up to the hoop first.  This will bring the booty onto the hoop.  Then bring up inside leg to hoop.  Remove top hand.
From Profile Sit cross grip, top hand to top bar, and bottom hand to bottom bar behind booty.  Bottom arm will be strong posting arm.  Move booty back off bar.
progressions: Level 3 version hand under tab instead of above tab.

teaching_cues: From DKH on top bar, bring hands to belly. Let torso extend, head towards the floor. Rest shoulders on hoop. Once shoulders are in place, bring hands inside hoop and around. Grab slightly below belly of hoop.One leg comes behind hoop while other one stays in front. Bring leg that is behind hoop to rest on hoop, bring front leg off of bar and straighten it in front of you for split. Keep the majority of your weight forward. Your back leg will prevent you from going too far.

From DKH on top bar, bring hands to belly. Let torso extend, head towards the floor. Rest shoulders on hoop. Once shoulders are in place, bring hands inside hoop and around. Grab slightly below belly of hoop. Extend both legs and bring one in front of hoop and one behind for pencil shape.

Starts from high Inside Lion (have hip above bar). Hand matching knee hook leg to top of bar with palms away grip. Rotate belly to floor. Exit back to Inside Lion by dropping booty and reblocking shoulder.

From horse on bottom bar, pull up so bar comes to mid thigh. Bend front knee. Hands come slightly below belly palms away (everyone’s hand placement will be a bit different depending on arm length and shoulder mobility). Lean forward and go around bar, pushing leg into bar and motorcycle gripping hoop. Roll stops and starts in the same position.

From straddle back on the bottom bar, bring one leg to meet the other. Engage core, chest, shoulders, etc. Keep hips up to bar by using same arm as leg that comes across to manually pull hips up toward bar. May bend arm to pull hips up. VERY core heavy.

display_name: Hip Hang Foot Block One Leg Straight

teaching_cues: Get into a profile plank and lift outside leg up and point it straight up, pushing against the bar.
Start from flying saucer, bend legs

Three different entries in order of difficulty: 1) Hoop at hip height. Stand to the side of the hoop. Bring head thru to the other side of the hoop. Arm that matches side head is on is the posting arm and the other arm is palm towards you below the tab. Hoop will be placed at the groove at the bottom of skull. Remove feet from ground. Two blocking points are posting arm and groove below skull. 2) From Man in the Moon, hand that matches lower leg is placed below tab. Other hand is posting arm. Remove top leg and then lower leg. Head is always on one side of the hoop and body on the other side of the hoop. Removing one leg at a time will allow student to stabilize without all weight dropping at one time. 3) From Man in the Moon as in progression 2, but both legs come off the hoop at the same time. Booty slides to the side which allows the posting arm to be placed.

From Man in the Moon, place bar in groove at base of skill, lower leg straightens and comes to top belly of hoop, same hand under tab. Slide booty to the side to place posting arm, other leg comes off the hoop on side opposite of head.

From dragonfly, post into dragon fly arm and move bar from armpit to shoulder/head/neck. If you feel comfortable with the set up, can let go with top hand. 

More entries to pose in Amazon in Level 1 section.
From Dragonfly, knees to chest, roll belly to hoop and block with top of ankles.

display_name: Ankle Hang Top Bar - Holding On
teaching_cues: From DKH, move hands to mid belly on hoop. Extend one leg at a time, pushing against the spanset and squeezing feet inward. May use hands to support some of your weight and to avoid slipping down to tops of feet.

display_name: Ankle Hang Top Bar - No Hands
teaching_cues: From DKH, move hands to mid belly on hoop. Extend one leg at a time, pushing against the spanset and squeezing feet inward. May use hands to support some of your weight. Ease down to tops of feet and may let go of hands if feel stable.
From Single Knee Hook/Horse, hand matching leg in hoop holds top bar. Other hand releases. Free leg bends towards leg in hoop. To lessen bar pressure on leg in hoop, engage leg.

From standing inside hoop, bend knees to get armpits closer to top bar. Put bar directly in armpits and push shoulders away from ears. Straight legs and take them off the hoop. May put one foot in front of hoop and one behind to avoid the hoop flipping.

From standing on the bottom bar, both hands on one strap. If hands are on right strap, then right leg swings around to hoop and foot is placed toes forward on that side - remaining leg follows, so now standing on bottom bar of opposite side of the hoop. Both hands then on left strap, and repeat above until standing back on original side of hoop.

From Butt shelf, hold onto bar by hips. Let your legs fall behind you while you arch your back. May take trial and error to find perfect balance point. Once you are balanced, you may let go with one hand or both. **Very back heavy**

display_name: Bird’s Nest Bottom Bar One Leg
teaching_cues: From Butt Shelf, remove back arch, and let booty slide off the bar, block with ankles. Remove one leg and drop it forwards or backwards. Leg on hoop can bend at knee or stay straight.
From Butt Shelf, remove back arch, and let booty slide off the bar, block with ankles.

display_name: Bird’s Nest Top Bar Single Leg
teaching_cues: From DKH on the top bar, extend one leg straight up to touch spanset. Unhook other leg to bring in front of hoop towards face. Free leg can be straight or bent.
From DKH on top bar, extend one leg at a time to touch spanset, resting the spanset on the top of the foot. Bend knees and arch back.

display_name: Butt Shelf - Legs Straight Above No Hands
teaching_cues: From regular buttshelf, bring legs closer together. Use the tops of your feet to hook on hoop for stability. If you feel comfortable, you can let go.

From buttshelf, think about keeping a “shelf” by the booty by arching the back slightly and pushing legs into hoop. This will happen naturally for some people who have a booty. If you feel stable, you may leg go with both hands.

display_name: Butt Shelf - One Leg Straight Other Bent Behind
leg_position: one leg straight one leg bent behind
teaching_cues: From butthshelf, bring one leg to the middle but keep it behind the hoop. Other leg extends behind. May be done with foot in front of hoop or bending the knee and pushing the bottom of the foot against the top bar.
Bar at sacrum, forearms resting behind hoop, grip below belly. Arch back and straight legs come up behind bar to top of hoop. Back stays arched.
From Butt Shelf Legs Wide Holding On, bring legs together.
From Pencil Stag under the bar, legs go forward, overhead, with one leg going to one side of the bar and the other to the other side of the bar. May release one hand.
Start from Knee Hook Layout Under Bar, straighten hooked leg, then free leg comes up and crosses over the ankle of the other leg. Bar between feet.

From DKH on the top bar, bring one hand to the knees then the other. Think about engaging the hamstrings and squeezing heels toward butt. Hoop may flip up. May manually flip the hoop up first before cannonball to feel more comfortable if need be.
From Chest Stand, one leg comes off and behind the hoop to straighten by belly of hoop.
From Chest Stand, one leg comes off the hoop, and drops behind bent.
From DKH on the top bar, bring hoop in front of you by ducking head while moving hoop. Hands come to belly of hoop. Bring bar to chest then straight legs toward ceiling.

From DKH on the top bar, bring hoop in front of you by ducking head while moving hoop. Hands come to belly of hoop. Bring bar to chest. Take legs off of hoop and bring into pike position. Your weight should now be in your hands and where your chest meets the bar.
From Profile Plank, release top hand and roll away from hoop (hoop will be behind you).
From layout, one leg crosses over the other and traces the hoop. No rounded back - back straight.

From DKH, put one hand on either spanset and climb up. Hoop will flip up. Bring one hand across both spansets and grab while the other hand grabs the flipped up hoop. Don’t put weight into the hand on the flipped up hoop. Cross one leg over the other.

From cuddle, adjust body so you can grab the hoop near your hips. Baseball grip. Hoop must be in knee pits. Adjust hoop if need be to do this. Tuck chin to chest. Roll forward, keeping knees bent. End with both legs (outside knee hooks) still hooked to bar. Most common issue is students not keeping bar in knee pits and plopping to the floor. Can spot by holding legs and guiding them to the bar.

From DKH, on the top bar, move both hands to the outside of the tabs, one hand being closer to the belly. 

Option one: Unhook the same leg as hand on belly. Rehook outside of the tab. Do the same for the other leg hooking next to the first leg. Slightly release grip with knees to slide down, letting your hand slide with you. Should end in cuddle. 

Option two: Unhook both legs from DKH, bring to outside of hoop below tab. Slide legs and hand down at the same time.

From seated on the top bar, lean to one side, bringing one hand to the same side spanset and other hand to the bar. You stay in the hoop by maintaining the spanset in the hip crease. Weight should be in hip crease. May let go if you feel stable.
Shoulder block on one side. Booty drops back off the bar.
From Delilah, release same hand as free leg and hold bottom center of the bar. Arch the back. Free leg comes forward with pointed toes and replaces hand that was at bottom center.
From Delilah, release same hand as free leg and hold bottom center of the bar. Arch the back.
Starts from Man in the Moon. One hand top of the bar and the other bottom of the bar. Using arms, pull up/push up, and hook outside leg to the top of the hoop.

alt_name: Knee Hang Top Bar Straight Leg Delilah (free leg straight)
teaching_cues: From seated, come to DKH on top bar. Both hands inside the tabs. One leg comes off and thru hoop. Straighten free leg.

Dragon Fly
Lean back over bar with belly to the ceiling
Leg of posting arm hooks at hip crease on bottom bar
Other leg straightens under tab of opposite side of bar
Seated on bottom bar. Hands to top of the bar. Drop back to knee pits.

Start from standing on floor, slide over to one side of the bar, with bar placed under that armpit. Post with other hand at about 4:00 and keep that arm straight and pushing (post). When comfortable, lift both legs with knees bent. Make sure shoulders aren’t shrugged.

From standing, crouch down to hoop. Elbow hook one arm then the other. One hand should be on one side of the hoop, one should be on the other. Slowly put more weight in your elbow hook. If you feel comfortable, bring legs up to tuck.

Can babystep this by slowly putting weight in elbow crease or elbowhooking one arms and regular grip with the other.

From sitting in hoop, elbow hook one arm then the other. One hand should be on one side of the hoop, one should be on the other. Slowly put more weight in your elbow hook. If you feel comfortable, bring body off hoop and hang by elbows. 

Can babystep this by slowly putting weight in elbow crease or elbowhooking one arms and regular grip with the other.

display_name: Elbow Hook Single Inside Knee Hook Single
teaching_cues: From DKH on bottom bar, hold on with one hand on either side of knees. Release one leg off hoop and straighten it. Elbow hook same leg as knee hook. Let go with other hand.
Top bar double knee hook. Hand that will match single knee hook moves to under the tab. Release matching arm and leg.
From Wine Glass, hand underneath Wine Glass leg, and invert.

display_name: Figure Four Foot Block Under Bar
teaching_cues:
From hip hang, grab both hands by hips (either palms away or towards). One leg extends up toward top bar and presses against bar. Other leg comes out of hoop and around to front of hoop to make 4 shape. 

This pose is more grip heavy than it seems. Because the hoop is no longer in your hip crease, the majority of your weight is now in your hands.

From Standing Outside of Hoop (toe squat, duck head under to other side of top bar, arms under top bar and grab straps as high as possible, arch back and stand). Reaching high on straps, lean forward, on leg off hoop/bend leg/toes pointed towards other leg, arch back). Pose can only be done with long straps.
From Fish, one leg points to the ceiling. Can also start from Prowl and the raise one leg with toes pointing the ceiling.
Start from “L” Sit. With legs and arms straight, raise hips to the bar and arch back.
Standing to the side of the hoop, if hoop at right hip, left hand to top center of bar (palms away), and right hand to bottom center of bar. Feet come off the floor. Shoulders away from ears.

display_name: Flamenco Grip Inside Mermaid Knee Hook
teaching_cues:
From Flamenco Grip Inside Mermaid, leg that matches Flamenco Grip hand hooks over that arm.

Grip must be low under tab, so knee can hook.
Starts from Standing Outside the Hoop. Lower down so the bar is underneath the shoulder blades. Hands grab belly of bar and raise the hoop.
From Gazelle, with leg blocks in place, remove one hand at a time and place them on bent knee.

From Profile Plank, one bootie check on the other side of the bar. Leg that matches the lower hand is the Gazelle leg. Gazelle leg bends (past bar - hip mobility may limit that). Gazelle leg presses against hoop as well as free leg for blocking.
From Gazelle, remove hand that matches bent leg, and place it on bent knee.

Profile Plank with one booty cheek on each side of the bar. Outside leg hooks over the same arm as outside leg. Release opposite arm from hoop. 

Arm length and thigh diameter may make this move not possible to achieve.

Profile Plank with one booty cheek on each side of the bar. Outside leg hooks over the same arm as the outside leg and then straightens. Release opposite arm from hoop. 

Arm length and thigh diameter may make this move not possible to achieve.

From Profile Plank, one bootie check on the other side of the bar. Leg that matches the lower hand is the Gazelle leg. Gazelle leg bends (past bar - hip mobility may limit that). Gazelle leg presses against hoop as well as free leg for blocking. Front leg hooks around bar and foot comes around as well. Hip mobility is a limiting factor.

From Profile Plank, one bootie check on the other side of the bar. Leg that matches the lower hand is the Gazelle leg. Gazelle leg bends (past bar - hip mobility may limit that). Gazelle leg presses against hoop as well as free leg for blocking. Straighten front leg.

From Profile Plank, one bootie check on the other side of the bar. Leg that matches the lower hand is the Gazelle leg. Gazelle leg bends (past bar - hip mobility may limit that). Gazelle leg presses against hoop as well as free leg for blocking.

May let go with both hands if feeling confident.

Starts from Hip Hang. Flip and come to the floor with legs crossed. Common Misalignment: shoulders by ears. Will not be able to land with legs crossed if the hoop is too high. Can also Genie Dismount from single knee hook on bottom bar with hands cross grip on side of hoop.
From Inside Mermaid with cross grip at belly of hoop, top leg bends towards chest.
From Inside Mermaid with cross grip right under tab, top leg bends towards chest.
From Butt Shelf, one leg bends towards chest and other straight behind.

display_name: Half Beauty Roll - from High Outside Mermaid
teaching_cues:
High Outside Mermaid (hand between top of hoop and tab to leave room for body to pass thru) and bend top leg.
Rotate belly towards ceiling and bent leg with pass through arm and side of hoop.
Free arm then passes through by straightening arm and using that arm to push the hoop away.
Pull up with top arm, straightening legs (to avoid crotch), and pass body through space by following the arm
Inside Lion

display_name: Half Beauty Roll - from Inside Lion
teaching_cues:
Inside Lion
Arm of free leg reaches up and through hoop for Flamenco Grip (hand between top of hoop and tab so there is room for head to pass through)
Head slides out between arm and hoop
Lean back so free arm can pass through body and side of hoop
As arm passes through, turn shoulders to face it, straighten arm and use the back of that arm to push hoop away
Pull up with top arm, straightening legs (to avoid crotch), and pass body through space by following the arm
Inside Lion on opposite side
Start with appropriate progression, then lean forward with hands slightly below belly of hoop, keep knee tightly bent and hands held on. Tuck the chin
progressions:
1. 1 leg on floor, palms away, slowly bring chest down to leg, tuck the chin, keep leg hooked the whole time. Hands slightly lower than belly of the bar
2. Start without the foot on the floor, still keeping chin to chest
3. Don’t bring chin to chest

teaching_cues: From seated, bring one leg off hoop and behind hoop. Straighten legs. Grab both hands to the side of the leg that is behind the hoop. Keep hoop near upper thigh of leg that is still in hoop. Think about swinging your legs in an arch/rainbow and squeeze your thighs together. Bring your legs through the center of the hoop, using your arms to support yourself. Bar should move from one inner thigh to the other inner thigh. Roll out the opposite side of booty block.

display_name: Hip Hang Foot Block Both Legs
teaching_cues:
From hip hang, bring both hands to grab by the hips. Straighten one leg up to press against the top bar. Straighten other leg to meet it.

This pose is more grip heavy than it seems. Because the hoop is no longer in your hip crease, the majority of your weight is now in your hands.
One hand top of the hoop. Lean back with the other arm extended. Scissor legs (higher leg will match hand off of the bar).
Hands below tabs. Lean back in reverse plank with straight back. Widen legs.
From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips away from hoop. Top hand moves to top of bar.

Palms facing away is an option, but most students are more successful with palms towards you. Must maintain flex arm hold until inverted. Hips to the bar and legs through hoop - not to ceiling. Will be easier the higher the hoop - able to use more momentum.

progressions:
1. one leg at a time, so remaining leg offsets gravity, 
2. both legs at the same time, 
3. pike legs with legs sliding against hoop

display_name: Hip Hang Foot Block One Leg Bent
teaching_cues: Lower leg can also be straight. Hoop size will determine where straight leg blocks - may be off to side instead of at top.
From hip hang, hold one hand on either side. Extend one leg to top bar and push against it. Other leg bends knee toward chest to keep bar in hip crease. May leg go if feel confident.
From hip hang, grab by your hips. Allow your legs to come to the outside of the hoop while keeping legs wide. Bend knees to hook around bar. Let go with hands.

From seated on the bottom bar, bring hands to the outside of the tabs. Bring hips up and feet to either side of spanset. Zipper the legs up and thru the hoop. Bring hips to bar. Fold into bar for hip hang. 

Can also be done from standing and zippering legs up from there. This variation is significantly harder.

Start with flex arm grip. One leg at a time comes from back of hoop to block on front of hoop. Zipper feet up hoop and then lower legs to Hip Hang. May be a progression towards flipping into the hoop.
From hip height hoop, place bar at hip crease with hands by legs. Lower down to hip hang. Chin to chest.
From hip hang on the top bar, hold outside of the tabs. Bring one leg of the top bar and thru the hoop. May let go if feel confident.

From hip hang, bring both hands to one side. Bring the opposite leg of whatever side you're leaning to out of hoop and around. Keep leg that’s in piked toward facer to keep leg inside hoop. 

Will feel very pinchy at first. Most common mistake is people not piking the leg towards the face. Without this step, the bar comes out of the hip crease. May use hand to hold leg that’s staying in hoop. May be done without hands with feel confident. 

Another option is to bring one hand to the side of hoop and other in between the legs. Some people find this grip to be more supportive.
From seated on bottom bar, slide back, straighten one leg, take other leg off hoop and behind. Back to seated - straighten leg on hoop, bring other leg back onto hoop.
Starts from Inside Lion. Hand, that matches leg in hoop, palms away to top of hoop. Shoulder that is blocked moves from in front of the hoop to behind the hoop.

From DKH on top bar, bring one hand outside of tab down towards belly of hoop. Whatever hand is lower, that leg comes off of top bar and thru hoop. Slide remaining leg down like cuddle slide while bottom hand slides if need be. End in inside lion.

From standing outside of the hoop, Bring both hands on either spanset and bring one leg into the hoop. Bring head and upper body thru the hoop. Bring spanset to armpit. Leg should be on one side and torso on the other. May hold on to spanset and hoop near opposite side of hooked leg. Other leg stays behind hoop and straightens.
From single knee hook/horse, slide up, block with opposite shoulder from leg in hoop.
From seated on top bar, hold straps, open hips and lower so bar is at sacrum and invert. Grab hoop and raise it behind you. Butterfly legs.

From seated on the top bar, bring one leg behind the bar and one leg in front. Press them against sides of hoop for running man. Grab spanset and slowly tip yourself upside down so that your thighs touch the spanset. May let go with one hand. Only let go with both if feel extremely confident in pose.
From seated on top bar, hold straps, open hips and lower so bar is at sacrum and invert. Grab hoop and raise it behind you.
From seated on top bar, hold straps, open hips and lower so bar is at sacrum and invert. One leg crosses in front of both straps and the other drops back.
From seated on top bar, hold straps, open hips and lower so bar is at sacrum and invert.

Start in Diving Bird or Butt Shelf. Straight leg moves from side of the bar to the top of the bar. Food of bent leg hooks around hoop. Can flex top foot for a block, as well as ankle pressing against bar, and work on letting go with hands.

display_name: Knee Hang Bottom Bar Single - One Hand
teaching_cues: From double knee hook, remove one leg (most students will need to externally rotate).
Seated on hoop, hands under tabs, slide down to double knee hook.

display_name: Knee Hang Double Top Bar - No Hands
teaching_cues: From DKH on top bar, squeeze heels towards glutes. Let go with hands if feel confident in knee hook.

display_name: Knee Hang Top Bar Back Press Away
teaching_cues: DKH on top bar. Hands come to belly of hoop. Squeeze heels towards butt to stay in DKH and push arms behind. May come into backbend to make it look prettier.

display_name: Knee Hang Top Bar Forward Press Away
teaching_cues: DKH on top bar. Hands come to belly of hoop. Squeeze heels towards butt to stay in DKH and duck head to bring hoop in front of you. Push arms away.

display_name: Knee Hang Top Bar Hands High
teaching_cues: Come to DKH by bringing each toe pit to the top bar then bringing each knee pit to the top bar. Squeeze heels toward butt. Hands stay inside of tabs.

display_name: Knee Hang Top Bar Hands Low
teaching_cues: Come to DKH by bringing each toe pit to the top bar then bringing each knee pit to the top bar. Squeeze heels toward butt. Hands slide down bar and come to belly of hoop.
Hands are cross grip. One leg has an inside knee hook while the other leg is straight. Belly to ceiling. Hips squared.

From Inside Lion, cross grip with hand matching leg in hoop palms away and the other palms towards you. Keep sure knee hook. Roll forward to single knee hook under the bar. Progressions can be keeping free leg on the floor and lean forward with chest to leg prior to roll.

Hands on top of the bar. Toe pit of one foot on bar, butt heavy, other foot on bar. 

Or enter from Trash Can.
modifications: one foot stays on the floor.
common_errors: legs, arms, and back not straight.

teaching_cues: From Man in the Moon, cross legs on opposite sides of the bar.

Begin from Profile Plank then bring one booty cheek to the other side of the bar (like with Gazelle). Inside leg bends and place foot of hoop on bar like with MIM. Outside leg straightens and passes thru to other side of hoop and blocks below tab. Elbow hook the inside arm. Release other arm. MIM foot comes off the bar and ankle rests on the front of the bar.
From Inside Lion, hands cross grip between legs with the hand matching the knee hook leg to be a palms away grip. Solid knee hook and roll forward to Delilah.
progressions: Regression would be to pancake chest to leg prior to rolling.

teaching_cues: WHen coming into man in moon, lean the torso back and slide down the hoop slightly. Can also get into it by going to regular MIM and using hands to manually slide yourself down lower.
From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips away from hoop. Top hand comes below tab to grab.

display_name: Man in Moon Low Legs Crossed
teaching_cues: Come into man in moon. May hold on one hand on top bar and one around booty on bottom bar. Straight one leg at a time. May use spanset to support feet.

Come to MIM. Hands may come to top bar or one on top bar and one on bottom (personal preference, some people find one way more supportive than the other and vice versa). Use hands to pull up and use core to stabilize yourself while you bring legs off hoop. Maybe also be done with legs bent like butterfly stretch. The butterfly option is less intense on the hip flexors and is slightly less intense on abs since the lever is shorter.

display_name: Man in the Moon Press Away
teaching_cues: Begin in Man in the Moon with legs high on the bar. Both arms to head side of hoop, and bar goes under armpit of arm closest to hoop. Cross grip. Straighten legs.

From Profile Sit, walk hands back on the top bar until your shoulder rests on the bar (shoulder block). Bottom bar may be on the same booty cheek or the opposite. Knees together. Blocking: feet push against bar and shoulder pushes against bar. Both hands stay on the bar for Intro.
modifications: Can move down to a lower Man in the Moon of the bar is on the tailbone.

teaching_cues: From DKH top bar, take off one leg and replace it with elbow hook. Can bring head through the hoop. Can post with opposite hand onto bottom bar. Careful during entry as hoop may tip.

From DKH on the bottom bar, bring hands to either side of hips. Release one leg off. Elbow hook same arm as leg that is knee hooked. Other hand releases. Straighten free leg toward ceiling. Elbow hook arm can grab free leg to make pretty pose.

From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips toward inside of hoop. Top hand grabs top bar with flamenco grip (palm toward you by rotating shoulder). If students don’t sink booty off and just rotate, they may roll right out of the hoop.

From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips toward inside of hoop. Maybe let go with bottom hand if you feel stable.Top leg of mermaid reaches across hoop for split. If students don’t sink booty off and just rotate, they may roll right out of the hoop.

From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips toward inside of hoop. Maybe let go with bottom hand if you feel stable. If students don’t sink booty off and just rotate, they may roll right out of the hoop.
Seated, both hands to one side, sink down to knees.

From DKH on top bar, bring one hand outside of tab further down towards belly. Whatever hand is lower, that opposite leg comes off of top bar and thru hoop. Slide remaining leg down like cuddle slide while bottom hand slides if need be. End in outside lion.
From seated on the top bar, bring one leg to outside of spanset and hook. Keep the other leg in. Hold onto spansets and sink booty off the hoop. Come to armpit of opposite side leg for outside lion.
From dragonfly, bring same leg as posting arm in hoop. Bend that knee. Hoop should be in opposite side armpit.

From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips away from hoop. Top hand moves to top of bar. Top leg comes thru hoop and bends at knee. Rotate leg/hips so that belly is facing downward.
From seated, bring both hands to one side. Sink booty off hoop then rotate hips away from hoop. Top hand moves to top of bar. Top leg comes thru hoop, crosses over bottom leg and straightens.

Hook one leg on the bar. Hands come to either side of hooked leg (can be palms away/palms toward/baseball grip). Lift hips up to bar for pencil then rotate butt towards front leg side. Bend knees in that direction and allow hips/butt to come to same side hand.

Hook one leg on the bar. Hands come to either side of hooked leg (can be palms away/palms toward/baseball grip). Lift hips up to bar for pencil. Turn hips to side of bar, facing opposite side of leg in front. Both legs bend. Front leg bends behind you while the back leg bends in front of you for stag.

Hook one leg on the bar. Hands come to either side of hooked leg (can be palms away/palms toward/baseball grip). Lift hips up to bar for pencil. Front leg extends in front of you and back leg extends toward the opposite side hand of front leg for straddle.
From DKH on the bottom bar, hold hands outside of hips. Bring one leg out of hoop. Hips up to bar and straighten both legs.

From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Back leg comes to bar/spanset as front leg extends toward floor. May shift weight forward. The back leg pushing against the hoop prevents you from shifting too far.

From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Bring legs to surround hand of opposite side hand of the leg that is in front. Turn torso toward legs and pike.

From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Turn butt towards hand of leg that is in front. May rest butt/groin on hand. Bend knees and arch back.

From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Front leg rests against same side spanset. Other leg comes to side of hoop to create star shape.

From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Front leg bends behind you, leg behind hoop bends in front of you to create stag legs.
From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Push legs wide into straddle.

From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs. Rock weight forward, using the back leg to prevent you from going to far forward. Rock weight back, using front leg to prevent you from going to far back. Repeat.
From DKH, bring hands inside tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring one leg behind the hoop and keep one in front. Push hips up toward bar and straighten legs.

Starting from a bottom bar double knee hang. Start by taking off one leg at a time and straightening it, with hands holding onto the bar. When safe, take off the other leg and straighten it. Keep upper body stacked

From seated, sink to knees (Trash Can). Keep one hand on top bar and bring other to outside of legs, hands palms away. Move the hand thats on the top bar to the outside of legs on the bottom bar quickly. Once hand has securely grabbed bar, come into pike below bar.

Starting from a top bar double knee hang. Start by taking off one leg at a time and straightening it, with hands holding onto the bar. When safe, take off the other leg and straighten it. Keep upper body stacked. Hoop may shake slightly, engage core.

From horse, pull up so hoop is on inner thigh/right below booty cheek. Squeeze butt like your life depends on it. This will avoid the bar slipping to unfortunate places. Hands come to top bar and may be used to support some of your body weight by pulling up. Arch back and bend legs behind you.

From horse, pull up so hoop is on inner thigh/right below booty cheek. Squeeze butt like your life depends on it. This will avoid the bar slipping to unfortunate places. Hands come to top bar and may be used to support some of your body weight by pulling up. Straighten legs

display_name: Pretzel Hang Low Bar Hands On
teaching_cues: From SKH on bottom bar, bring both hands to opposite side of bar as the leg thats hooked. Cross opposite side leg knee pit over foot of leg that is hooked. Use the crossed leg to push into other leg to keep knee hook.

display_name: Pretzel Hang Low Bar No Hands
teaching_cues: From SKH on bottom bar, bring both hands to opposite side of bar as the leg thats hooked. Cross opposite side leg knee pit over foot of leg that is hooked. Use the crossed leg to push into other leg to keep knee hook. If you feel confident, you can let go with both hands.

display_name: Pretzel Hang Low Bar One Hand
teaching_cues: From SKH on bottom bar, bring both hands to opposite side of bar as the leg thats hooked. Cross opposite side leg knee pit over foot of leg that is hooked. Use the crossed leg to push into other leg to keep knee hook. Let go with either hand.

display_name: Pretzel Single Arm No Knee Hook
teaching_cues: SKH bottom bar. Both hands to free leg side. Free leg arm under free leg and hand grabs bar. Remove KH leg. Can keep both hands on bar or remove free leg arm.
Cross grip hands right below the tab on one side of the hoop. Belly to the ceiling. Bring arm closest to hoop into elbow hook around bar. May let go with other hand.

display_name: Profile Plank L Pop with Split
teaching_cues: Get into a profile plank and lift outside leg up and point it straight up, pushing against the bar. Rotate hips toward bar if need be. Bottom leg reaches toward floor to create split/straddle shape.
Cross grip hands right below the tab on one side of the hoop. Belly to the ceiling. May let go with the lower hand.
Seated on bottom bar. One hand to the belly of the hoop, other by booty. Turn towards the hand on the belly of the hoop. Hand by booty crosses over on top of the other hand.
From L sit, reach hips toward top bar while one leg comes off and hooks on top bar. Squeeze knee and push bottom foot into bar. Hands inside tabs. This move requires a degree of hip flexibility.

From horse, pull up so hoop is on inner thigh. Both hands to opposite side of the leg in the hoop. Bring your torso out of the hoop and rotate leg that’s inside hoop to touch bottom bar.The bar should be touching the inner thigh/ calf of horse leg. Free leg comes through hoop. The outside of that foot should be pushing against the bar. 

Most common issue is hips not being to the bar and students not pushing their legs against hoop to stay up.

Single knee hook on bottom bar. Hands come on either side of leg, palms toward you. May be done with momentum by ticking toking back and forth or done without. Either way, drive free leg thru the center of the hoop. Bring the chest up and motorcycle grip. 

Most common issue is students landing in hok hang. This is most likely caused from not driving leg as much as needed and not bringing the chest up at the end of the roll.
From seated on the top bar, sink your booty thru the spanset while you lean back, legs going wide for straddle. May need to adjust where bar is on back. Bar should be above the butt, not below.

display_name: Scorpion - Knee Hang Outside Top Bar
teaching_cues: From standing inside the hoop, bring bar to hips and hands thru spansets. Hold onto hoop just below the tabs. Lean forward into hip hang, letting your legs go wide and knees bend to catch spansets. May let go after secured in pose.

From seated on bottom bar, bring bar to mid thigh. Bring hands to slightly below belly of hoop. Bend knees into butt and keep them bent the entire time. Tuck yourself into a ball, chin to chest and roll forward. Motorcycle your hands to bring you completely around the bar. Should end in seated again or in DKH if doing half roll, which would be Level 2.

From DKH on top bar, bring hands to belly. Let torso extend, head towards the floor. Rest shoulders on hoop. Once shoulders are in place, bring hands inside hoop and around. Grab slightly below belly of hoop. One leg stays hooked on top bar. Bring other leg behind hoop and straighten to side to make arrow shape.

From DKH on top bar, bring hands to belly. Let torso extend, head towards the floor. Rest shoulders on hoop while keeping knee hook. Once shoulders are in place, bring hands inside hoop and around. Grab slightly below belly of hoop. One leg remains bent on top of hoop while other comes off hoop to behind hoop and bends knee.

From DKH on top bar, bring hands to belly. Let torso extend, head towards the floor. Rest shoulders on hoop while keeping knee hook. Once shoulders are in place, bring hands inside hoop and around. Grab slightly below belly of hoop.
From Shoulder Stand, use arms to pull up, so pressure is off shoulders, yet bar still resting on neck below bone, then pike one leg at a time.
Top bar double knee hang. One leg zippers up the strap behind the hoop while the other leg comes behind the belly of the hoop. Hands can be under tabs or between tabs.

display_name: Single Knee Hang Bottom Bar 2 Hands
teaching_cues: From double knee hang, remove one leg. Most students will need to externally rotate to release the leg. If hoop is low enough, from standing, can hook one leg and then take the other leg off the floor.

From DKH on the bottom bar, squeeze heel toward butt. Release one leg off hoop, bringing it behind you. Hands come off hoop. 

**Requires a very strong knee hook. May modify by doing single knee hook with one hand holding on**

display_name: Single Knee Hook Back Press Away
Single Knee Hook Front Press Away

teaching_cues: From seated on bottom bar, lift toe pit and toe pit on the top bar, then knee hook to knee hook on top bar. Reach one hand at a time on each strap and use the strap to ladder climb to seated on the bar
From DKH on bottom bar, palms face toward you. Bring legs off hoop and tuck legs in toward chest. Rotate body and bring toes to floor. Come back up. **Shoulder heavy**

From DKH on top bar, hands come to hoop either in tabs or just outside of tabs. Bring legs off hoop and pike legs. Rotate body so feet are closer to ground. Only go down as far as you can come back up. Must have confident skin the cat on bottom bar. Very shoulder heavy. Don’t go down further than you can come back up. You will get stuck there since you can't push off the ground for leverage.

From DKH on bottom bar, Bring hands outside of legs palms facing toward you. Bring knees off of hoop and hook feet on each side of hoop. The lower your feet, the more of a backbend you come into. To get out bring booty below the bar and rehook legs in DKH. 

May also be done from buttshelf by bringing hands by hips (palms away) and sliding booty off while feet hook.

Starting from double knee hang on bottom bar, bring body up to touch the bar, move one leg and turn it out to push up against the side of the bar, then take the other leg and do the same thing on the other side.

Starts from DKH top bar. Straighten one leg and thread foot around strap. Remove the other leg, cross over body, feed the foot thru the arm and bar (the window). Slide leg around the hoop while externally rotating hip. Thread foot on strap higher so that leg is fully straight.
From DKH on the top bar, bring one leg off and between you and the hoop. Slide it around the hoop while externally rotating hip. May keep top leg bent or straighten it for full split.
From an L sit, take one foot off and bend the knee. Option for open hip splits down (becomes more of a straddle instead of split)

From Stag, knee hook arms reaches across to the other side of the bar, roll out, and hook inside knee hook on straight leg. For outside knee hook, free leg hand reaches across to the other side of the bar. Progression: Use one hand only - free leg hand only for inside knee hook and bent leg hand stays on for outside knee hook.
From wine glass, bring both hands to the belly, reaching above wine glass leg. Bring hips to bar and free leg thru hoop to rest against side of hoop with stag legs.

From horse/single knee hook, pull up and lean forward through the hoop with straight arms, palms away. The bar (weight) should be on the back leg. Squeeze booty. Shoulder mobility and hoop diameter may be a factor in entrance and exit - may need to use one shoulder at a time.

display_name: Stand in Hoop Star One Leg
teaching_cues: From standing in hoop, with body in between straps, take one leg off and push it straight behind while the other leg remains on the bar and pushes in the opposite direction. When pushing forward, toes, remain on the bar.

From standing in hoop, where your body is in between the straps and hands are holding onto the hoop to push yourself up. Shoulders should not be up by your ears. Slowly take one leg off and then the other. Push both legs out to opposite sides, in a star position.
Toe squat on bottom bar. Grab each spanset in each hand one at a time. Straighten legs and stand up while holding onto spanset.

Come to standing outside the hoop. Come into the hoop by bringing one arm in, the head in, then the other arm in. Both legs touch bottom of hoop. Lean to one side. The opposite leg of whatever side you leaned to comes off for arabesque.

Come to standing outside the hoop. Come into the hoop by bringing one arm in, the head in, then the other arm in. Both legs touch bottom of hoop. Lean to one side. The same side leg of whatever side you leaned to comes off for arabesque.

From standing in hoop, where your body is in between the straps and hands are holding onto the hoop to push yourself up. Shoulders should not be up by your ears. Slowly take one leg off and bend it backward in the air. When safe, take the other leg off and bend forward in the air.
From Toe Squat, hands grab span set one at a time. Stand using legs (stand straight and knees forward). Hips to hoop. Can come through and shoulder block with both arms.

From DKH on the bottom bar, bring hands inside of legs. Push hips up toward bar and bring legs off hoop and out toward sides. Think about “stacking” everything. Hips, torso, chest, and shoulders should all be in line. Keep chest up and thru hands. May need to bring space between hands if have bigger chest.

From seated on bottom bar, drop back to Trash Can with legs wide. One hand top bar and one between legs hands - both hands palms away. Release top hand and grab bottom bar between legs - palms away. Momentum will bring legs overhead to straddleback. First time spot - hold each ankle until top hand grabs bottom bar and then release ankle hold.

display_name: Straddle Back Inside Outside Top Bar
teaching_cues: From DKH, one hand moves under tab and then other between legs. Straddle back. Hand underneath tab also stops hoop from flipping up.

From DKH on top bar, bring hips toward bar and froggy legs (bend knees into butterfly and bring calves to hoop). Let hoop flip up, this will happen regardless. Extend legs for straddle back. 


**Should have a SOLID straddle back before doing this move**
From hip hang, grab both sides of the bar with palms facing away on the belly of the bar. Lift your body up, with legs straight, pointed behind in a “superman” position.
From hip hang, engage core and glutes to come up to superman. May use hands to get into position first and find “sweet spot”. Chest should be up. Everything is engaged: glutes, legs, abs, upper back.

From standing outside of hoop, bring both hands to one side of spanset. Whatever side you reached to, that foot comes out and around hoop then back in. Other leg crosses over like candlestick pose. Inside arm elbow hooks on spanset, other can leg go. Stay in place by squeezing legs together to avoid slipping.

alt_name: Around the World Threaded Leg Exit
teaching_cues: Start by standing on the bottom bar. Both hands on one strap. If holding onto the right strap, the right leg swings around to front of hoop (causing hoop to start to turn) and foot feeds over bar, underneath the leg remaining on hoop. Right had reaches for top bar, palm away. Foot on hoop comes off, and left hand slides down strap. Land in Horse.
Squat with lower bar at toe pits of both feet. May enter from “L” Sit. Shoulder relaxed - not by ears.

display_name: Top Bar Sit Reach for Hoop
teaching_cues: From seated on bottom bar, lift toe pit and toe pit on the top bar, then knee hook to knee hook on top bar. Reach one hand at a time on each strap and use the strap to ladder climb to seated on the bar. As the bar flips up, slowly remove one hand from a strap and reach behind to hold onto the hoop.

Wine Glass
Hands at Hoop Belly
Free Leg from Back to Front of Hoop
Lift Body Off Hoop (inside leg thigh only will be touching hoop)


Hands higher than belly if need more booty clearance.
Start from HH. Cross ankles. Legs raise wide to hoop as torso twists. Hip of inside leg will be touching the bar. May be easier to bring back leg to hoop first and then front leg.

From DKH on the top bar, bring hands away from the tabs slightly (no quite just below tabs but also not at the belly). Come into pencil and allow your legs to come to same hand as the leg that is in front of the hoop. Squeeze legs around hoop. Easiest entrance is from Scorpion top bar.

Both hands to one side. One leg comes into the hoop and bends for a knee hook. Hands climb up the side of hoop and eventually make it to the top bar. 

This move is as easy or as hard as you make it. The higher the hands, the less you have to climb. The lower the hands (ex. Starting all the way below the bar) makes it harder.

From dragonfly, same leg as posting arm comes through the hoop. Leg straightens. 

Also possible from seated and buttshelf. If performing from buttshelf, cue a REALLY big sit up. If students don’t sit up and just take their leg out of hoop while in buttshelf, they will fall out.
From Fallen Angel, free leg foot hooks around bar.
